title: Lana C FDE 4438 NDE 4438
content: I am going to send it to you as a word document. It's a long story and I've written it just two months ago, it's taken me this long to come out with it: It's taken me far too long to tell this story. I told my husband, daughter and mother immediately but other than that, I kept it to myself for two and a half years. I just told a few people at that time. It's been over five years and I should have told this many years ago. Wednesday, April 21, 2004: I told my husband that I had a feeling that I was going to be extremely lucky on Friday. His response was, 'Yeah, right. 'I said, 'No, I really mean it. I feel like I'm going to be extremely lucky on Friday, I mean really lucky! I have a feeling I might win the lottery or something.' I won the lottery all right, but not in a way anyone could imagine. Friday, April 23, 2004: I left work at United Airlines around 1:00 pm. There was construction on the interstate, and I found myself frustrated because everyone was passing me. I thought 'Don't they know they are supposed to go slow in a construction zone?' All of a sudden, I was taken out of existence. It was as if I were not on this planet, didn't exist, whatever you want to call it - I was not a part of the life zooming past me on I-85. I had no vision whatsoever. I heard the flutter of wings, like the sound of a flock of birds taking off. I looked to my right to see what the noise was. I saw about thirty to forty angels descending from the sky. They descended so smoothly. They were all talking amongst themselves, so I couldn't understand what they were saying. It was like when a crowd of people is talking, and you can't make out what they are saying because too many people are talking at once. Their magnificence was like nothing I had ever witnessed. Their wings had hues of blue and purple with the tips turning more of a silvery white. They were very statuesque, lined up in two rows in a strong protective stance. Their faces were distorted. In the distance far behind them, I saw an orange/yellow glow. No introduction was needed; I knew immediately that it was the Lord. The love that flowed from Him was beyond measure. In those split seconds, I sensed His love for not only me, but His love for His angels and enormous pride in their job-well-done. My whole body was consumed with love and comfort beyond anything that a human can express to another. The best way to describe it is a feeling of total love, comfort, warmth and security. At that time, I heard the angels all gasping in unison. That was when I came back into existence. I was headed right into the back of a flatbed eighteen-wheeler that had a small bulldozer attached to the back of the truck. I thought, 'Oh crap, I'm about to hit this truck.' I swerved right and clipped the backside of the truck. I almost missed it!! The engine came up through the floorboard of my little RAV4 and almost severed my foot completely. I got out of the truck and started walking down the interstate. I wondered why I was walking funny, looked down and I was walking on the stump of my leg, with my foot pushed up toward the side of my leg. The shock of what I had just witnessed and of what had just happened was incredible. By now, people had begun to come to my aid. I wanted to ask them, 'Did you just see what I saw?' I had a feeling they didn't. I was losing blood fast and trying to hang on to consciousness. There was a black man and a white man that immediately went to work on my leg. They cut my pantyhose off and tied a tourniquet around my leg. This sounds crazy but I remember thinking, 'That black man does not care that he has my blood on him.' In an exceptionally unselfish act, they had no gloves to protect themselves from my blood that covered them. A nice, compassionate lady also stopped to help. I could tell by her expression that I was in trouble. All I kept saying was 'Someone please help me, I have a little girl at home.' I must have said it a million times. I was taken to a trauma hospital in Atlanta. While in the ambulance, the attendant told me, 'I don't know if you realize how lucky you are, those two guys that helped you were from the Fairburn Fire and Rescue.' They just happened to be on their lunch break at the same time, same place, as me. What are the odds of that? She said 'Another thing, Medical Flight was ordered but you got lucky, someone just declined this ambulance just one exit away and they sent us down for you.' Had those two men not been there, I probably would have bled to death before the ambulance got there. It was all in place for me to survive that day. I know in my heart that it was no coincidence and I have my heavenly Father to thank. While in the hospital, a chaplain came by my room to talk to me. I asked him, 'Why do you go around to each room?' He said, 'It's because you are on the trauma floor and most people who have gone through trauma need to talk to someone.' I started crying and said, 'I saw Him.' I told him my story and he said, 'I've heard that many times before, of course not the exact same story, but similar stories with the same result.' His last words to me were 'Whatever you do, don't keep this story to yourself.' That summer 'I Can Only Imagine' by Mercy Me was constantly on the radio. How appropriate! I'm telling my story so all will know our Father is real and His love is beyond anything we could ever imagine.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: “taken out of existence… not on this planet, didn't exist… I had no vision whatsoever.”

arrival.other_being_detail: “about thirty to forty angels descending from the sky… In the distance far behind them, I saw an orange/yellow glow… I knew immediately that it was the Lord.”

environment.environment_other_detail: “orange/yellow glow” behind the angels; wings with “hues of blue and purple… silvery white.”

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: “I'm telling my story so all will know our Father is real and His love is beyond anything we could ever imagine.” (also reinforced by chaplain: “Whatever you do, don't keep this story to yourself.”)

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Motor vehicle collision/near-collision on I-85; severe leg injury with major blood loss.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experience described as being “taken out of existence” with no vision; heard wing flutter; saw angels; sensed the Lord and overwhelming love; then angels gasped and she “came back into existence” immediately before impact.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Transitional removal from normal reality (no tunnel) → angelic scene + Lord’s presence/light → abrupt return to roadway/body awareness before crash impact.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience occurred immediately before the collision: “I was taken out of existence… That was when I came back into existence. I was headed right into the back of a flatbed eighteen-wheeler…” (more like an FDE/averted-death episode than a classic post-clinical-death NDE).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I saw about thirty to forty angels descending from the sky.” / “In the distance far behind them, I saw an orange/yellow glow… I knew immediately that it was the Lord.” / “My whole body was consumed with love and comfort beyond anything that a human can express to another.”
